items: Identify target surface before any mutation.
Classify action as repo_curated_write, tempdir_write, connector_write, live_system_change, or destructive_change.
Require separate explicit approval for connector_write, live_system_change, or destructive_change.
Block action if target path or connector identity is ambiguous.
Do not enumerate paths in one shell and delete through another shell.
Resolve absolute targets before any move/delete proposal.
Prefer inspection and validation over mutation in phase artifacts.
Record local head, upstream head, and drift.
Stage exact current-phase artifact paths only.
Run whitespace and staged diff checks.
Commit, push explicitly, fetch again, and verify local equals remote.
